_comment: Catalog of Local Group Policy / security settings this tool can read, compare and apply. 'type' selects the mechanism: 'secedit' settings live in the Local Security Policy database (read via `secedit /export`, written via `secedit /configure`); 'registry' settings are Administrative-Template / security-option style values written directly under the policy or system hives. Values are stored/compared as strings. 'serviceImpacts' rules power the pre-apply scan: if a running service/process matches while the setting differs from the baseline, it is flagged.

PasswordMinLength.name: Minimum password length
PasswordMinLength.description: Fewest characters a local account password may contain.

generalImpact.detail: Accounts with shorter passwords must change them at the next password change. Service accounts with hard-coded short passwords may fail to authenticate until updated.

PasswordComplexity.name: Password must meet complexity requirements
PasswordComplexity.description: Requires a mix of character classes and forbids the account name in the password.

generalImpact.detail: Simple or dictionary passwords will be rejected on next change. Automated provisioning that sets weak passwords will fail.

MaxPasswordAge.name: Maximum password age
MaxPasswordAge.description: Days before a password must be changed (0 = never expires).

generalImpact.detail: Service and application accounts with non-expiring passwords will begin expiring. This is the single most common cause of scheduled tasks and services failing after a policy roll-out — set those accounts to 'password never expires' first.

serviceImpacts.detail: Long-running services often authenticate with a dedicated account. Enforcing password expiry can lock them out on the expiry date.

MinPasswordAge.name: Minimum password age
MinPasswordAge.description: Days a password must be kept before it can be changed again.

generalImpact.detail: Prevents users from cycling passwords to defeat history. No service impact expected.

PasswordHistorySize.name: Enforce password history
PasswordHistorySize.description: Number of previous passwords remembered and blocked from reuse.

generalImpact.detail: Users cannot reuse recent passwords. No service impact expected.

ClearTextPassword.name: Store passwords using reversible encryption
ClearTextPassword.description: Reversible encryption stores a recoverable form of the password and should be disabled.

generalImpact.detail: A few legacy authentication methods (e.g. CHAP for some RAS/802.1X configurations, older IIS Digest auth) require reversible encryption. Those will stop working when it is disabled.

serviceImpacts.detail: RAS/NPS or IIS Digest authentication may rely on reversible-encryption passwords.

LockoutThreshold.name: Account lockout threshold
LockoutThreshold.description: Failed logon attempts allowed before the account is locked (0 = never lock).

generalImpact.detail: Applications that retry stale/cached credentials (mapped drives, Outlook, mobile mail, service accounts) can trip the lockout repeatedly. Audit for bad-credential retries before enforcing a low threshold.

serviceImpacts.detail: Services that repeatedly present cached credentials can lock out the account under a low threshold.

LockoutDuration.name: Account lockout duration
LockoutDuration.description: Minutes a locked account stays locked (0 = until an administrator unlocks it).

generalImpact.detail: Longer durations increase help-desk load; no direct service impact.

ResetLockoutCounter.name: Reset account lockout counter after
ResetLockoutCounter.description: Minutes after a bad attempt before the failed-attempt counter resets.

generalImpact.detail: No direct service impact.

GuestAccountDisabled.name: Disable the built-in Guest account
GuestAccountDisabled.description: The Guest account should be disabled on all systems.

generalImpact.detail: Anonymous/guest file share access will stop working. Kiosk or shared-appliance setups that rely on Guest will need a real account.

serviceImpacts.detail: Shares that permit Guest access will refuse anonymous connections once Guest is disabled.

LimitBlankPasswordUse.name: Limit local account blank-password use to console
LimitBlankPasswordUse.description: Blocks network logon for local accounts that have blank passwords.

generalImpact.detail: Local accounts with blank passwords can no longer be used over the network (recommended). Lab devices relying on blank-password network logon will break.

NoLMHash.name: Do not store LAN Manager hash on next password change
NoLMHash.description: Stops Windows from storing the weak LM hash of passwords.

generalImpact.detail: Windows 95/98/ME and some very old appliances that only speak LM authentication will no longer be able to authenticate.

serviceImpacts.detail: Legacy clients that only support LM hashes will fail against file sharing or RAS.

LmCompatibilityLevel.name: LAN Manager authentication level
LmCompatibilityLevel.description: Controls which challenge/response protocols (LM, NTLM, NTLMv2) are used. 5 = send NTLMv2 only, refuse LM & NTLM.

generalImpact.detail: Refusing LM/NTLMv1 (level 5) breaks authentication to and from devices that only support the older protocols: old NAS units, multifunction printers with scan-to-folder, and legacy line-of-business apps.

serviceImpacts.detail: File sharing and scan-to-folder printing with legacy devices may fail once only NTLMv2 is accepted.

RestrictAnonymousSAM.name: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts
RestrictAnonymousSAM.description: Blocks anonymous listing of local account names.

generalImpact.detail: Some legacy trust or migration tools that enumerate accounts anonymously may lose visibility. Rare in practice.

InactivityTimeoutSecs.name: Interactive logon: machine inactivity limit
InactivityTimeoutSecs.description: Seconds of inactivity before the session is locked (0 = disabled).

generalImpact.detail: Kiosks, dashboards, digital-signage PCs and monitoring stations that must stay unlocked will lock automatically. Exclude those machines or raise the limit for them.

UacEnableLUA.name: User Account Control: run all administrators in Admin Approval Mode
UacEnableLUA.description: Master switch for UAC. Should be enabled.

generalImpact.detail: Enabling UAC where it was off requires a reboot and can break legacy apps that write to protected locations without virtualization. Turning it off entirely is a security regression and is never recommended by any of these standards.

serviceImpacts.detail: Legacy line-of-business apps that assume they run elevated may need shims or a manifest once UAC is enforced.

UacAdminPrompt.name: UAC: behavior of the elevation prompt for administrators
UacAdminPrompt.description: 2 = prompt for consent on the secure desktop (recommended baseline).

generalImpact.detail: Silent-elevation deployment scripts that assumed no prompt may now prompt. Schedule those to run as SYSTEM.

SmbV1Server.name: Disable SMBv1 server protocol
SmbV1Server.description: SMBv1 is obsolete and insecure; the server component should be disabled.

generalImpact.detail: Devices that only speak SMBv1 lose access to shares on this machine: Windows XP/2003, some NAS/multifunction printers, and older backup appliances. Requires a reboot to fully unload.

serviceImpacts.detail: The Server service is running and may be sharing files to legacy SMBv1-only clients.

RdpRequireNla.name: Require Network Level Authentication for RDP
RdpRequireNla.description: Requires the client to authenticate before a session is created.

generalImpact.detail: RDP clients that do not support CredSSP/NLA (very old thin clients, some non-Windows RDP apps) will be unable to connect.

serviceImpacts.detail: Remote Desktop is enabled; legacy RDP clients without NLA support will be refused.

RdpMinEncryption.name: Set RDP client connection encryption level to High

generalImpact.detail: Extremely old RDP clients that cannot do 128-bit encryption will be refused. Rare today.

serviceImpacts.detail: Remote Desktop is enabled; only very old clients would be affected.

FirewallDomainEnable.name: Windows Firewall: Domain profile enabled
FirewallDomainEnable.description: The host firewall must be on for the Domain profile.

generalImpact.detail: Turning the firewall on can block inbound ports that line-of-business apps rely on until matching allow rules exist. Confirm required inbound rules before enforcing.

serviceImpacts.detail: Server services listening for inbound connections may be blocked until firewall allow rules are added.

FirewallStandardEnable.name: Windows Firewall: Private profile enabled
FirewallStandardEnable.description: The host firewall must be on for the Private profile.

generalImpact.detail: As with the Domain profile, confirm required inbound rules first.

serviceImpacts.detail: Inbound listeners may be blocked until allow rules exist.

FirewallPublicEnable.name: Windows Firewall: Public profile enabled
FirewallPublicEnable.description: The host firewall must be on for the Public profile.

generalImpact.detail: Public networks should always have the firewall on. Minimal expected impact.

DisableAutoRun.name: Turn off AutoPlay / AutoRun on all drives
DisableAutoRun.description: 255 = disable AutoRun on every drive type.

generalImpact.detail: Kiosks or media appliances that auto-launch from inserted media will no longer do so.

PsScriptBlockLogging.name: Enable PowerShell Script Block Logging
PsScriptBlockLogging.description: Logs the content of PowerShell script blocks for audit.

generalImpact.detail: Event log volume increases. Heavy PowerShell automation can generate a large number of 4104 events.
Security event log volume increases. Ensure the Security log is large enough or forwarded.
Security event log volume increases.
Records account creation/changes. Minimal volume.
Records changes to audit and security policy. Minimal volume.
Success auditing of privilege use is very high volume and can flood the Security log. Many baselines audit failures only.
Enables auditing of file/registry access where SACLs are set. Can be extremely high volume if broad SACLs exist.
Records system start/stop and security subsystem events. Minimal volume.

RestrictAnonymous.name: Network access: do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares
RestrictAnonymous.description: Blocks anonymous listing of accounts and shares. A few legacy trust/migration tools that enumerate anonymously may lose visibility.

generalImpact.detail: Blocks anonymous listing of accounts and shares. A few legacy trust/migration tools that enumerate anonymously may lose visibility.

EveryoneIncludesAnonymous.name: Network access: let Everyone permissions apply to anonymous users
EveryoneIncludesAnonymous.description: Anonymous users no longer inherit Everyone permissions.

generalImpact.detail: Anonymous users no longer inherit Everyone permissions.

DisableDomainCreds.name: Network access: do not allow storage of passwords and credentials
DisableDomainCreds.description: Windows will not cache network credentials. Scheduled tasks or mapped drives relying on stored credentials may prompt or fail.

generalImpact.detail: Windows will not cache network credentials. Scheduled tasks or mapped drives relying on stored credentials may prompt or fail.

ForceSubcategoryAuditPolicy.name: Audit: force audit policy subcategory settings to override category settings
ForceSubcategoryAuditPolicy.description: Required so advanced (subcategory) audit policy is honoured instead of the legacy nine categories.

generalImpact.detail: Required so advanced (subcategory) audit policy is honoured instead of the legacy nine categories.

RunLsassAsPPL.name: Configure LSASS to run as a protected process (RunAsPPL)
RunLsassAsPPL.description: Protects LSASS from credential theft, but blocks unsigned LSASS plug-ins. Some third-party SSO/AV agents and smart-card middleware may stop loading until updated/signed.

generalImpact.detail: Protects LSASS from credential theft, but blocks unsigned LSASS plug-ins. Some third-party SSO/AV agents and smart-card middleware may stop loading until updated/signed.

RestrictRemoteSam.name: Network access: restrict clients allowed to make remote calls to SAM
RestrictRemoteSam.description: Limits remote SAM enumeration to Administrators. Tools that remotely enumerate local accounts as non-admins will be denied.

generalImpact.detail: Limits remote SAM enumeration to Administrators. Tools that remotely enumerate local accounts as non-admins will be denied.

NtlmMinClientSec.name: Network security: minimum session security for NTLM SSP clients
NtlmMinClientSec.description: Requires NTLMv2 session security and 128-bit encryption for outbound NTLM. Legacy servers that cannot negotiate these will refuse the client.

generalImpact.detail: Requires NTLMv2 session security and 128-bit encryption for outbound NTLM. Legacy servers that cannot negotiate these will refuse the client.

NtlmMinServerSec.name: Network security: minimum session security for NTLM SSP servers
NtlmMinServerSec.description: Requires NTLMv2 session security and 128-bit encryption for inbound NTLM. Legacy clients will be refused.

generalImpact.detail: Requires NTLMv2 session security and 128-bit encryption for inbound NTLM. Legacy clients will be refused.

AllowNullSessionFallback.name: Network security: allow LocalSystem NULL session fallback
AllowNullSessionFallback.description: Prevents NTLM NULL session fallback for LocalSystem.

generalImpact.detail: Prevents NTLM NULL session fallback for LocalSystem.

LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy.name: Apply UAC token-filtering to local accounts on network logons
LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy.description: Local admin accounts get a filtered token over the network, blocking remote admin via local accounts (pass-the-hash mitigation). Remote management tools that rely on a local admin account may break.

generalImpact.detail: Local admin accounts get a filtered token over the network, blocking remote admin via local accounts (pass-the-hash mitigation). Remote management tools that rely on a local admin account may break.

WDigestUseLogonCredential.name: Disable WDigest clear-text credential caching
WDigestUseLogonCredential.description: Stops WDigest from caching plaintext credentials in memory (mitigates Mimikatz). No impact on modern authentication.

generalImpact.detail: Stops WDigest from caching plaintext credentials in memory (mitigates Mimikatz). No impact on modern authentication.

DontDisplayLastUser.name: Interactive logon: do not display last signed-in user
DontDisplayLastUser.description: The username field is blank at logon. Minor convenience impact on shared kiosks.

generalImpact.detail: The username field is blank at logon. Minor convenience impact on shared kiosks.

RequireCtrlAltDel.name: Interactive logon: require CTRL+ALT+DEL
RequireCtrlAltDel.description: Forces the secure attention sequence before logon (anti credential-harvesting).

generalImpact.detail: Forces the secure attention sequence before logon (anti credential-harvesting).

SmartCardRemovalBehavior.name: Interactive logon: smart card removal behavior (lock workstation)
SmartCardRemovalBehavior.description: Locks the session when a smart card is removed. No effect where smart cards are not used.

generalImpact.detail: Locks the session when a smart card is removed. No effect where smart cards are not used.

UacInstallerDetection.name: UAC: detect application installations and prompt for elevation
UacInstallerDetection.description: Legacy installers are detected and prompted for elevation.

generalImpact.detail: Legacy installers are detected and prompted for elevation.

UacSecureUiaPaths.name: UAC: only elevate UIAccess applications in secure locations
UacSecureUiaPaths.description: UIAccess apps must reside in a secure path (Program Files / System32).

generalImpact.detail: UIAccess apps must reside in a secure path (Program Files / System32).

UacUiaDesktopToggle.name: UAC: allow UIAccess applications to prompt without the secure desktop

UacAdminApprovalBuiltin.name: UAC: admin approval mode for the built-in Administrator

UacStandardUserPrompt.name: UAC: behavior of the elevation prompt for standard users (auto-deny)
UacStandardUserPrompt.description: Standard users cannot elevate; requests are automatically denied. Apps that expect standard users to elevate on demand will fail.

generalImpact.detail: Standard users cannot elevate; requests are automatically denied. Apps that expect standard users to elevate on demand will fail.

UacVirtualization.name: UAC: virtualize file and registry write failures to per-user locations
UacVirtualization.description: Legacy apps writing to protected locations are redirected instead of failing.

generalImpact.detail: Legacy apps writing to protected locations are redirected instead of failing.

UacSecureDesktop.name: UAC: switch to the secure desktop when prompting for elevation
UacSecureDesktop.description: Elevation prompts appear on the secure desktop.

generalImpact.detail: Elevation prompts appear on the secure desktop.

MssDisableIpSourceRouting.name: MSS: (DisableIPSourceRouting) IPv4 source routing protection
MssDisableIpSourceRouting.description: Highest protection; source-routed IPv4 packets are dropped.

generalImpact.detail: Highest protection; source-routed IPv4 packets are dropped.

MssDisableIpSourceRoutingV6.name: MSS: (DisableIPSourceRouting IPv6) IPv6 source routing protection
MssDisableIpSourceRoutingV6.description: Highest protection; source-routed IPv6 packets are dropped.

MssEnableIcmpRedirect.name: MSS: (EnableICMPRedirect) allow ICMP redirects to override OSPF routes
MssEnableIcmpRedirect.description: ICMP redirects can no longer override the routing table.

MssNoNameReleaseOnDemand.name: MSS: (NoNameReleaseOnDemand) ignore NetBIOS name-release requests
MssNoNameReleaseOnDemand.description: Protects against NetBIOS name-release denial of service.

generalImpact.detail: Protects against NetBIOS name-release denial of service.

SafeDllSearchMode.name: MSS: enable Safe DLL search mode
SafeDllSearchMode.description: System directories are searched before the current directory for DLLs (DLL-planting mitigation).

generalImpact.detail: System directories are searched before the current directory for DLLs (DLL-planting mitigation).

SmbServerSignRequire.name: Microsoft network server: digitally sign communications (always)
SmbServerSignRequire.description: Requires SMB signing on the server side. Legacy clients/devices that cannot sign will fail to connect to shares.

generalImpact.detail: Requires SMB signing on the server side. Legacy clients/devices that cannot sign will fail to connect to shares.

serviceImpacts.detail: The Server service is running; devices that cannot perform SMB signing will lose access to its shares.

SmbServerSignEnable.description: Enables SMB signing when the client supports it.

SmbServerForceLogoff.name: Microsoft network server: disconnect clients when logon hours expire
SmbServerForceLogoff.description: Clients are disconnected when logon hours expire.

generalImpact.detail: Clients are disconnected when logon hours expire.

SmbServerAutoDisconnect.name: Microsoft network server: idle time before suspending a session (minutes)

SmbServerRestrictNullSess.name: Microsoft network server: restrict null-session access
SmbServerRestrictNullSess.description: Anonymous (null) sessions cannot access shares/pipes not explicitly allowed.
